admission.justification: Confusing unreadability with known absence or hiding a recorded empty field silently changes what the reader can infer from the comparison.

applicability: The selected reviewer subject's one-sided statement and visible non-authored field-value rendering.
conditions: Rendering follows the two declared operand states; an absent side may be the stated empty diff operand, but an unreadable side may not.
A non-authored value is unrecorded only when undefined; a recorded empty string keeps its own explicit label.
exclusions: Mounting a knowledge pane when no subject is selected.
Reintroducing authored text values into Technical details or the non-authored field list.
statement: The knowledge pane renders a one-sided statement's available text beside the explicit named absent/unreadable side, and names absent vs recorded-empty field values without printing either as blank.
